extraction.method: Read-only OOXML extraction of shared strings and worksheet cells, followed by an explicit hierarchy reconstruction from the workbook's spatial layout.
assumptions: Blank cells are layout gaps and do not create placeholder nodes.
Columns B, C and D usually represent root, section and group depth; columns E onward usually represent pages and items.
Rows 19-38 are a parallel-column taxonomy: each heading in E19:P19 owns the non-empty cells directly below it in the same column until row 38.
Repeated Finite Map and Infinite Map rows own their same-row Interior view and following-row Exterior view.
No merged-cell text was expanded into synthetic labels; only cells containing source text became nodes.
The wording, capitalisation, punctuation and source spelling are preserved exactly.
